name: Windrose
scope: Solo worlds only. Do not use in co-op or on a server.
notes: Windrose is in Early Access and updates often; every update can break cheats. Vanta refuses a cheat when its AOB is not found exactly once.
No anti-cheat, but co-op sessions (up to 4 players) are shared: only use Vanta in a solo world. The game's EULA does not allow cheating in multiplayer.

Checked on Steam build 24803703 with the game running (read-only): every AOB has exactly 1 hit and every value offset was read from the game's own type information. None of the cheats has been tried in-game yet; cheats whose effect depends on an undocumented game formula are marked experimental.
Character cheats work once you are in your world. You can turn toggles on in the menu: they wait and start by themselves.
Back up your save first: %LOCALAPPDATA%\R5\Saved\SaveProfiles\<Steam ID>
Windrose is Early Access en krijgt vaak updates; elke update kan cheats breken. Vanta weigert een cheat als de AOB niet precies één keer gevonden wordt.
Geen anti-cheat, maar co-op-sessies (tot 4 spelers) zijn gedeeld: gebruik Vanta alleen in een solowereld. De EULA van de game staat valsspelen in multiplayer niet toe.

Gecontroleerd op Steam-build 24803703 met de game open (alleen lezen): elke AOB heeft precies 1 treffer en elke waarde-offset is uit de eigen type-informatie van de game gelezen. Geen enkele cheat is al in-game geprobeerd; cheats waarvan het effect van een ongedocumenteerde formule afhangt zijn experimenteel.
Personage-cheats werken zodra je in je wereld bent. Je kunt toggles al in het menu aanzetten: ze wachten en starten vanzelf.
Maak eerst een backup van je save: %LOCALAPPDATA%\R5\Saved\SaveProfiles\<Steam ID>
nl.scope: Alleen solowerelden. Niet gebruiken in co-op of op een server.

cheats.name: Infinite Jumps
cheats.description: The jump counter counts down instead of up, so you can keep jumping in mid-air.

nl.name: Oneindig springen
nl.description: De sprongteller telt af in plaats van op, dus je kunt in de lucht blijven springen.

cheats.confidenceNote: From a public Cheat Engine table (April 2026): 'inc [rbx+468]' becomes 'dec' (1 byte); JumpMaxCount is not touched, so turning it off restores normal jumping (after landing). AOB checked on Steam build 24803703 (Windrose-Win64-Shipping.exe, 2026-09-28): exactly 1 hit on disk; [rbx+468] is JumpCurrentCount. Also 1 hit in the running game (live check 2026-09-29). Not tested in-game yet. Fails safe: if the AOB is not found exactly once, Vanta patches nothing.

cheats.name: Unlock Travel
cheats.description: Removes a game check that blocks travelling (the source table calls it 'Unlock travel'). Side effects: what exactly it unblocks is not documented and it may allow travel the story does not expect yet. Solo worlds only; save first.

nl.name: Reizen ontgrendelen
nl.description: Haalt een controle weg die reizen blokkeert (de brontabel noemt het 'Unlock travel'). Bijwerkingen: wat het precies vrijgeeft is niet gedocumenteerd en het kan reizen toestaan dat het verhaal nog niet verwacht. Alleen solowerelden; sla eerst op.

cheats.confidenceNote: From a public Cheat Engine table (2026, client and server versions). AOB checked on Steam build 24803703 (Windrose-Win64-Shipping.exe, 2026-09-28): exactly 1 hit on disk. It NOPs 'mov r8d,[rdx+rcx+10]'. Also 1 hit in the running game (live check 2026-09-29). Not tested in-game yet. Fails safe: if the AOB is not found exactly once, Vanta patches nothing.

cheats.name: Infinite Health
cheats.description: Keeps your health at your maximum health (it follows level-ups and gear). Turn it on in the menu and it starts working once you are in your world.
cheats.hint: Load into your world first (the value is read from your character).

nl.name: Oneindige gezondheid

nl.hint: Laad eerst je wereld (de waarde wordt van je personage gelezen).

cheats.confidenceNote: Checked live on Steam build 24803703 (2026-09-29, game running, read-only): the base AOB (GEngine, no hook needed) has exactly 1 hit, and the offsets were read from the game's own Unreal type information (R5AttributeSet.Health at +0x30 and MaxHealth at +0x50, FGameplayAttributeData: BaseValue +8, CurrentValue +0xC; read 480/480 live). Every 200 ms Health.Current and Health.Base are set to MaxHealth.Current; a MaxHealth of 0 (loading) is never copied. Not tested in-game yet. Fails safe: if the base AOB is not found exactly once, Vanta writes nothing.
